# Shared library-search cases.
#
# Replayed by both implementations, so they cannot drift apart:
#   - native/linthra_core/src/shared_cases_test.rs (Rust, the reference)
#   - test/core/catalog/search_shared_cases_test.dart (the Dart fallback)
# A case both must agree on goes here, not in one side's own tests.
#
# One case per line, fields separated by a single TAB. `#` starts a comment
# line. A field of a lone `-` means "none". Escapes inside a field:
# \t (tab), \n (newline), \\ (backslash), \u{HEX} (any code point).
#
#   T  <text>  <expected tokens, separated by single spaces>
#      How text is cut into folded tokens, for metadata and queries alike.
#
#   R  <id>  <title>  <artist>  <album>  <album artist>  <provider>
#      A track of the catalog that the M lines below it search. Positions
#      count R lines from 0, in file order.
#
#   M  <query>  <positions of every matching track, ascending>
#      Every query term must start a token of some field of the track. A
#      term that starts no token of any track may instead match one within
#      its typos (F below).
#
#   F  <term>  <token>  <true | false>
#      Whether a folded query term matches a token, or the start of one,
#      within its typos: none under 4 characters, one up to 6, two from 7;
#      the first character must match; a swap of two neighbours is one typo.

# --- Tokens -------------------------------------------------------------
